summary: Thursday: Four mega-cap earnings reactions at open (TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT/META — $8T+ mcap). Jobless Claims + Durable Goods 8:30am. Iran ceasefire aftermath, oil above $129 USO. VIX 18.9, EARLY RISK-OFF (0.599). Barbell strategy: AI semis + defensive quality + clean energy.

risks.label: Mega-Cap Earnings Reactions ($8T+ mcap)
risks.detail: TSLA, GOOGL, MSFT, META reported Wednesday AMC. Their pre-market reactions dominate Thursday open. Bull: all beat → VIX 16, regime upgrades to RISK-ON. Bear: any major miss → VIX 22+, full RISK-OFF. Monitor futures 4-9:30am ET before entering any position.

risks.label: Iran Ceasefire Aftermath — Oil $129
risks.detail: Negotiations remain uncertain post-expiry. USO above $129. Geopolitical risk premium persists. VIX spike risk if talks collapse. Energy sector bid continues but all energy names already in open positions.

risks.label: EARLY RISK-OFF Regime (Score 0.599)
risks.detail: At upper bound of EARLY RISK-OFF band. VIX trending up (16 → 18.9) despite SPY at 52w highs. Position sizing 0.75x. Three binary catalysts in 48h: earnings reactions, Jobless Claims, Durable Goods.

risks.label: FOMC Apr 28-29 — Rate Decision Approaching
risks.detail: Fed expected to hold. PCE inflation data Friday will set tone. Oil rebound complicates disinflation narrative. Hawkish surprise = growth multiple compression across AI/semis.

risks.label: GDP Q1 Advance (Apr 30) — Recession Risk Check
risks.detail: First estimate of Q1 2026 GDP. Consensus +1.8% annualized. Below +1% would signal near-recession and trigger full RISK-OFF regime shift. Watch for manufacturing PMI confirmation.

events.label: TSLA/GOOGL/MSFT/META Earnings (Thu Pre-mkt)
events.detail: Four mega-caps report pre-market Thursday. Combined $8T+ market cap. Capex guidance from GOOGL/MSFT/META is the key variable for AI infrastructure stocks (AVGO, AMD, ASML). TSLA delivery guidance sets EV/autonomous sentiment.

events.label: Jobless Claims (Thu Apr 24 8:30am)
events.detail: Weekly initial claims. < 220K = labor resilient, risk-on signal. > 240K = labor softening, risk-off. Key ahead of FOMC next week.

events.label: Durable Goods Orders (Thu Apr 24 8:30am)
events.detail: March durable goods. Direct catalyst for DE (industrial capex). Above-consensus = confirms capital equipment cycle thesis. Below-consensus = industrial slowdown signal.

events.label: PCE Price Index (Fri Apr 25 8:30am)
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge for March. Hot print = hawkish risk ahead of FOMC. Core PCE consensus +2.6% YoY. Oil rebound may push headline higher.

events.label: FOMC Rate Decision (Apr 28-29)
events.detail: Fed expected to hold at 3.50-3.75%. Statement language on rate cut timing and inflation path is the market-moving variable. Powell press conference Wednesday Apr 29.

opportunities.label: AVGO AI Backbone Momentum — Score 90
opportunities.detail: Broadcom at 22x fwd PE, above all EMAs. Custom silicon for GOOGL/META/Apple. VMware integration adds $4B+ software revenue. Direct earnings catalyst Thursday. Highest-conviction AI infrastructure play.

opportunities.label: ASML EUV Monopoly — Score 89
opportunities.detail: ASML at $1418, above EMA200 ($1160). EUV monopoly — every advanced chip requires their machines. TSMC at 52w high confirms AI capex cycle. Mega-cap capex guidance = direct order pipeline catalyst.

opportunities.label: CRWD Cyber Hedge — Score 88
opportunities.detail: CrowdStrike -4.5% pullback entry in uptrend. Iran uncertainty = elevated cyber threat. AI-native Falcon platform ARR >30% YoY. Above EMA20/50 confluence support. BUY signal Apr 15 at $409.

opportunities.label: TAN Solar at 52w High — Score 86
opportunities.detail: Invesco Solar ETF +2.75% Wednesday. Oil $129 accelerates energy transition narrative. IRA $369B deployment ongoing. Above EMA200 ($48.46). 30+ holdings, no single-stock risk. Best R/R in clean energy.

opportunities.label: EWT Taiwan Breakout — Score 86
opportunities.detail: Taiwan ETF breaking above $84 near 52w high. TSMC (42% weight) at 52w high. Best R/R in scan (1:1.9). Zero US earnings binary risk — natural diversifier during mega-cap earnings week.

opportunities.label: LLY Healthcare Pullback — Score 87
opportunities.detail: Eli Lilly at 21.7x fwd PE, down 19% from $1134 high. GLP-1 secular growth driver. RSI 46.5 neutral. Defensive quality in EARLY RISK-OFF. Revenue independent of macro/earnings cycle.

regime_blips.label: SPY Near 52-Week High — Bullish Price Action
regime_blips.detail: SPY holding near 52-week highs despite EARLY RISK-OFF. Price action is bullish but VIX trending up. Mega-cap earnings reactions Thursday will either confirm breakout or trigger reversal.

regime_blips.label: VIX 18.9 — Rising Trend Bearish Signal
regime_blips.detail: VIX at 18.9. Two weeks ago it was 16. Each higher low signals institutional hedging activity. Sub-20 but trending up = EARLY RISK-OFF confirmed. Watch 22 as full RISK-OFF trigger.

regime_blips.label: DXY ~98.2 — Weak Dollar Supports Multinationals
regime_blips.detail: Dollar remains weak. Tailwind for ASML (EU), EWT (Taiwan), and multinational revenues. Commodity prices supported. International revenue FX translation boost for AVGO, LLY.

regime_blips.label: USO $129 — Oil Elevated Post-Ceasefire
regime_blips.detail: Oil holding above $129. All energy names already in open positions. Indirect beneficiaries: TAN (solar transition narrative), CRWD (geopolitical security spend). Watch $140 as regime-stress level.
